safety_line: Bites itch and can trigger flea allergy dermatitis in pets. See a doctor if bites become infected or you develop a rash that spreads.
traits: Pets scratching, plus bites appearing around human ankles
Reddish-brown to black, wingless, 1-3 mm, strong jumping legs
Black specks on pet bedding that turn red when wetted ("flea dirt")
Tiny jumpers in carpet, especially in shaded rooms

look_alikes.difference: Cat fleas are visible jumpers on pets and carpet; chiggers are outdoor-picked-up and too small to see, causing itchy welts at sock lines.
look_alikes.next_photo: A close-up of the biting insect if visible, versus just the bite pattern on skin.

copy.what_it_means: Adults on the pet are only about 5% of the infestation — the rest is eggs, larvae, and pupae hiding in carpet and bedding. Pet treatment alone tends to lose; home, yard, and pet together, timed to the life cycle, wins.
copy.fact: Adults on the pet are roughly 5% of the infestation — the other 95% is eggs, larvae, and pupae in carpet and bedding.
copy.blurb: Pet treatment alone loses. Home + yard + pet together, timed to the life cycle, wins.

tech_notes: IGR + adulticide inside/out; customer prep sheet mandatory (vacuum, wash bedding, pet treatment same week).
